api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://tiktok-user.p.rapidapi.com/searchuser/therock"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "tiktok-user.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

contents.desc: Appreciate chopping up depression with my guys on @The Pivot Podcast. I’ve worked hard over the years to gain the emotional tools to work thru any mental pain that may come to test me. But years ago I didn’t know what mental health struggle was. As men, we didn’t talk about it. We just kept our head down and worked thru it. Not healthy but it’s all we knew.
If you’re going thru your own version of mental wellness turning into mental hell-ness, the most important thing you can do is talk to somebody.
It can’t be fixed if you keep that pain inside.
Having the courage to talk to someone is your superpower. I lost two friends to suicide.
Talk to someone. Despite how you may feel, you’re never alone.
#mentalhealth
#ThePivot

contents.desc: One of my biggest “pivots” in my life was when I finally realized that the most powerful thing I can be ~ is myself.
It’s easy to say.
But it’s hard to do.
A funny thing happened though when I finally said, “fuck this, I’m gotta be me and do it my way - and if I fail then at least I fail being authentic”
The entire industry of Hollywood conformed around me. And then I went to work.
Tap in to my bio ☝🏾 to watch my full interview on @The Pivot Podcast

contents.desc: On behalf of our entire #YoungRock cast - thank you all so much for tuning in this season - the ups, downs and everything in between.
I’ll never forget the pain and worry on my mom’s face that day. As a 14yr old punk kid, I felt helpless because I couldn’t do shit about it. I fucking hated it.
(sorry to cuss)
But years later life came full circle.
* now I can hear @imkevinhart 👦🏾 saying right now “it’s about damn time you bought your mom a house” 😂😂
Shut up Kevin! 🤣
Over the years I’ve been lucky enough to buy my mom multiple homes - but this last surprise home was one she described as her “final dream home” where she’ll live the rest of her life.
I know I ain’t the only one who’s gone thru this, but when hard times hit, you either give up or it creates a grit and obsession.
cheers to grit & obsession 👊🏾
thanks again for tuning in.
#youngrock
